The King Who Held the Door — Koopa Troop (King) / Disaster Inc. (current situation)

Status: Active — operating in the Shadow Estate; carrying necromantic evidence; royal war chest active; illegal under hostile mandates and still completely unbothered

Bowser is the King of the Koopa Troop, a giant fire-breathing turtle-dragon who was cast into the Shadowfell during the Planar Fracture alongside Archie Miser. Since then, he has attended a vampire dinner party where he presumably sat wherever he wanted, tackled a vampire lord through a gothic window, bit a giant bat's wing, and most recently held a door shut against an axe-wielding succession claimant while Markop was unconscious—then punched said claimant in the head and picked up a necromancer's wand asking 'Is this a magic wand?' with the innocent curiosity of a child finding a toy. Waluigi has arm-wrestled Bowser and LOST. Waluigi has also competed against Bowser in every sport imaginable. Bowser is not complicated. Bowser is EFFECTIVE. The current party pass identifies Bowser as Disaster Inc.'s blunt-force sovereign: door-holder, threat magnet, and walking siege engine whose honesty remains more reliable than most alliances.

When Bowser is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, he drops to 1 hit point instead and roars. Once per long rest.
Bowser's speed is not halved while he grapples or carries a Medium or smaller creature, and he can carry one such creature while flying in the Koopa Clown Car (not on this sheet).

Koopa Troop creatures within 60 feet that can hear Bowser have advantage on saving throws against being frightened, and once per turn Bowser can use a bonus action to let one of them make a weapon attack as a reaction.

Status: Missing — Presumed alive, location unknown, last confirmed sighting 1039 BF at the Star Fountain

Mario is—or WAS—the most famous hero in the Mushroom Kingdom. The man who saved Princess Peach countless times before her assassination in 955 BF. The red-capped plumber who could jump higher than physics should allow, who stomped Bowser's schemes into the ground repeatedly, who was so synonymous with heroism that his NAME became a verb. And then, after eighty-five years of diminished appearances and growing silence, he DISAPPEARED entirely. Luigi found him at the Star Fountain. They flew together on wing caps. Luigi said 'Nothing can hurt us... as long as we're together.' And then Mario was GONE again, and Luigi is working alone for the Mages' Guild at Raventree Manor, sucking up ghosts with a vacuum cleaner and refusing to explain ANYTHING. Waluigi has spent considerable effort piecing together what happened. The picture that emerges is worse than a simple disappearance. WAH. When a creature Mario can see attacks Princess Peach or an ally within 5 feet of him, Mario can use his reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll; if it still hits, he can take the damage instead.

Toads and Mushroom Kingdom citizens who can see Mario have advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Once per long rest, as an action, he rallies: up to six allies within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to his level plus his Charisma modifier.
Mario cannot willingly abandon an innocent in danger he can see. He has advantage on saving throws against effects that would make him flee or stand aside.
